entities.name: Himoto
entities.description: The Kami of the Spark from Kamigawa, who lives in a mechanized origami tanuki robot and companions Kaito Shizuki.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: Planeswalker whose spark Himoto helped ignite.

entities.name: Emperor of Kamigawa
entities.description: Attacked by a metal-armed man and mysteriously disappeared.

entities.name: Tameshi
entities.description: Futurist moonfolk prodigy who designed Himoto's robot.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: A kami who was a fragment of a thing.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: Planeswalker whose spark was damaged by the Reality Chip and later lost in the Desparkening.

entities.name: Reality Chip
entities.description: Item that damaged the Wanderer's spark.

entities.name: Desparkening
entities.description: Event in which the Wanderer lost her spark.

events.summary: Himoto came into being the moment the Emperor of Kamigawa was attacked and disappeared.
events.quote: Himoto came into being the exact moment that the Emperor of Kamigawa was attacked

events.summary: Himoto was instrumental in igniting Kaito's spark after they decided to search for the emperor together.

relations.quote: She has become his companion in her robot form
